summary: An object is scaled to zero on an axis, so it is flat or invisible.
A Geometry Nodes modifier's group cannot run (a cycle, a missing Group Output, or a result too large), so the modifier leaves the mesh as it is.
A mesh object has no geometry.
A mesh has faces with no area (collapsed or repeated corners).
A closed mesh's faces point inwards, so it shades and exports inside out.
Some faces of a closed mesh point the other way from their neighbours.
A mesh with an image material has no texture coordinates, so the image shows as one colour.
The scene has meshes but no camera, so it cannot be rendered.
Nothing lights the scene and the world is dark, so renders come out dark.
A visible mesh is outside the camera's view.
A material is not used by any object.
